natural_body: 40% discounts raise acquisition and revenue but hurt retention and renewals.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion is directly down 4% QoQ, and prior evidence indicates shorter onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. This is a more sustainable response than broad discounting, whose retention and renewal harm is documented. Verify the onboarding and activation-message source records before finalizing the single experiment design.
